items.title: 66095_Benny Carter oral history interview
items.q: So then I went to this Lieutenant Michael, and I started studying with him.

ctx.x: Yes. Of course, after Lieutenant Michael, I studied with a man named Arthur Reeves, who really hit -- his emphasis was on sound. You know, and on articulation. And he got a wonderful sound. I really wanted to sound like him.
